title: Worker loss or short outages can strand initial reviews
problem: The new task uses Celery's default early acknowledgement and retries only three times with a five-second delay. A worker loss can remove the message before a `ReviewRun` exists. A longer GitHub or Temporal outage can leave no request, or a `QUEUED` run without a workflow. There is no scheduled reconciler for either state.
suggestion: Set `acks_late=True` and `reject_on_worker_lost=True`; the head-keyed dedupe makes redelivery safe. Use exponential backoff over a useful outage window. Reconcile stale `QUEUED` rows, and mark permanent failures as `FAILED`.
cluster_issue: Initial inbox review dispatch is fire-and-forget with no durable pending record or reconciliation, so a broker enqueue failure or exhaustion of the task's three retries silently drops the review
